title: Kelvin–Helmholtz billows
alt: A pale band of dye between two shear layers whose edges roll up into rows of spirals, outlined by a thin yellow-green line.
caption: Passive dye between two shear layers rolling up, Re = 400, t = 2 to 9.95. 384 × 192 Fourier modes, RK443, dt = 0.0025, CPU.

title: Swift–Hohenberg rolls
alt: Light and dark stripes appear out of grey noise, curve into a labyrinth and slowly straighten into patches of parallel rolls.
caption: Rolls of du/dt = r u − (1 + ∇²)² u − u³ at r = 0.1 growing from noise in a periodic box of 24 × 12 roll wavelengths, t = 10 to 3000 on a logarithmic clock. 192 × 96 Fourier modes, SBDF2, dt = 0.5.
